title: configure the fleetd Claude instance in T3's settings
create the fleetd instance's Claude login file (empty, 0600)
(re)start T3
command: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 systemctl --user enable fleetd-t3.service && XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 systemctl --user restart fleetd-t3.service

title: wait for T3 to answer
command: /usr/bin/node -e 'const u=process.argv[1]+"/.well-known/t3/environment";const end=Date.now()+180000;(async()=>{for(;;){try{const r=await fetch(u);if(r.ok){console.log((await r.json()).serverVersion);return}}catch{}if(Date.now()>end){console.error("T3 did not answer at "+u+" within 3 min");process.exit(1)}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000))}})()' http://127.0.0.1:3774

title: enroll the node with a one-time token (sent on stdin)
command: /home/wynn/.local/share/fleetd/bin/fleetd node join --hub https://forge.example.ts.net --token-file - --machine mac-mini --t3-home /home/wynn/.fleetd/t3 --t3-url http://127.0.0.1:3774 --t3-cmd '/usr/bin/env T3CODE_HOME=/home/wynn/.fleetd/t3 /usr/bin/node /home/wynn/.local/share/fleetd/npm/bin/t3' --t3-restart-cmd '/usr/bin/env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 systemctl --user restart fleetd-t3.service' --tags macos,xcode --home /home/wynn/.fleetd/node --enroll-only

title: (re)start the node
command: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 systemctl --user enable fleetd-node.service && XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 systemctl --user restart fleetd-node.service
